_doc: Character bible for the cinematic portrait pipeline (Phase 3, tools/cinematics/).
The ENGINE never reads this file — it only loads pre-generated 512x640 PNGs by
path. This bible is authoring-time data: it feeds prompt conditioning for the
portrait generator (tools/cinematics/portraits.py). Cast + roles are pulled from
id               stable key; also the portraits/<id>/ folder name
display_name     nameplate string shown in the cinematic line cue
role             one-line story role (for the author, not the prompt)
appearance       DETAILED physical description — the identity anchor that
conditions every generation for this character
personality      demeanor cues that steer expression/pose
reference_image  canonical headshot path; gen-line conditions ON this file

grayson.role: The player-character privateer; a freelance pilot dragged into the Steltek mystery.
grayson.appearance: Human man in his late 30s, weathered and lean with a strong jaw and a few days of dark stubble. Short dark-brown hair going slightly grey at the temples, cut practical. Sharp hazel eyes with crow's-feet from squinting at cockpit glare. A faint old scar through the left eyebrow. Sun-worn tan of someone who lives under station lights and hard vacuum.
grayson.personality: Dry, unflappable, quietly cynical. A working-class survivor who has learned not to trust easy money. Reads as tired but sharp; the faintest smirk.
grayson.wardrobe: Scuffed brown leather flight jacket over a grey utility undershirt, collar open. A worn pilot's harness with buckles at the chest. Utilitarian, lived-in, not military.

sandoval.role: First fixer at New Detroit; hands over the Steltek artifact as collateral, then turns up dead.
sandoval.appearance: Human man in his 50s, heavyset with a broad face, olive complexion, and a thick greying moustache. Small dark eyes that dart. Sweating slightly, the look of a man who owes the wrong people money.
sandoval.personality: Smooth-talking, ingratiating, nervous underneath. A dealer in 'acquisitions' who over-promises and never pays.
sandoval.wardrobe: A rumpled once-expensive maroon jacket with a loud collar, a gaudy ring, an open shirt. Cheap flash trying to look like real money.

tayla.role: Smuggling contact who employs the player across the Tayla arc; hard, professional, honest about being dishonest.
tayla.appearance: Human woman in her 40s, athletic and hard-edged, medium-brown skin, close-cropped black hair with a shaved side. High cheekbones, a level unsmiling gaze, dark brown eyes. A thin scar along the jaw.
tayla.personality: Cool, transactional, dangerous. Says exactly what she means. Respects competence, has zero patience for excuses.
tayla.wardrobe: A fitted dark tactical jacket with subtle armor panels, a high collar, a comm earpiece. Muted greys and gunmetal. All business.

lynch.role: New Constantinople crime boss who takes the artifact 'for study' and runs the player on increasingly ugly errands.
lynch.appearance: Human man in his 60s, silver-haired and immaculately groomed, pale, with cold pale-grey eyes and a thin cruel mouth. The composed stillness of a man used to being obeyed. Manicured.
lynch.personality: Urbane, patronizing, casually ruthless. Speaks softly and threatens with a smile.
lynch.wardrobe: A tailored charcoal suit with a dark silk cravat, a subtle metallic lapel pin. Old-money mobster elegance.

masterson.role: Oxford university administrator; gatekeeps the library archive behind four 'favors'.
masterson.appearance: Human man in his late 50s, thin and prim, balding with neat greying hair at the sides, wire-rimmed spectacles, a pinched disapproving expression and a narrow nose. Bloodless academic pallor.
masterson.personality: Fussy, transactional, self-important. A petty bureaucrat who enjoys the leverage his archive gives him.
masterson.wardrobe: A stiff high-collared academic tunic in deep blue with a university crest, a thin scarf. Formal, humorless.

murphy.role: Runs the Palan resistance from the Basra refinery; sends the player against the bounty-hunter blockade.
murphy.appearance: Human woman in her late 30s, wiry and tired, freckled fair skin, red hair pulled back in a rough braid with loose strands, sharp green eyes with dark circles. The lean look of someone running a losing fight on no sleep.
murphy.personality: Blunt, weary, determined. A idealist grinding on fumes; grateful but braced for more bad news.
murphy.wardrobe: A patched orange-and-grey refinery work coverall with rolled sleeves, a bandolier of tools, a resistance armband. Practical, grimy.

monkhouse.role: Xenoarchaeologist marooned on Palan; his artifact fragment completes the Steltek map.
monkhouse.appearance: Human man in his late 60s, frail and excitable, wild white hair, round wire glasses, a short white beard, deep smile lines, bright over-caffeinated pale-blue eyes. Bookish and thin.
monkhouse.personality: Eccentric, brilliant, endlessly enthusiastic. Talks too fast about ancient civilizations, nervous about the 'someone with fur' hunting him.
monkhouse.wardrobe: A rumpled sand-colored field jacket with too many pockets, a data-slate on a lanyard, a scarf against station chill. Dusty academic-explorer.

cross.role: Exploratory Services handler at Rygannon who runs the player through the frontier survey arc.
cross.appearance: Human woman in her 40s, calm and capable, warm brown skin, black hair in a tight professional bun, steady dark eyes, a faint pilot's tan-line across the brow. Composed.
cross.personality: Measured, professional, quietly protective of her survey pilots. Even-keeled even delivering bad news.
cross.wardrobe: A clean teal Exploratory Services flight uniform with a survey-net shoulder patch, a headset resting on the collar. Corporate-scientific.

terrell.role: Confederation admiral at Perry Naval Base; commands the fleet against the Steltek drone in the finale.
terrell.appearance: Human man in his 60s, broad-shouldered and imposing, dark skin, close-cropped grey hair and a neat grey beard, heavy brows over stern deep-set eyes. The bearing of decades of command.
terrell.personality: Gruff, blunt, contemptuous of civilians and paperwork alike. Grudgingly fair.
terrell.wardrobe: A crisp navy-blue Confederation admiral's dress uniform, gold braid at the shoulders, a chestful of service ribbons, high stiff collar.

vance.role: Merchant hauler captain leading a two-drayman convoy through Pender's Star; a lifer who has run this lane for decades.
vance.appearance: Human man in his 50s, broad and grizzled, ruddy weather-worn skin, a heavy salt-and-pepper beard, tired pale-blue eyes set in deep bags, a balding crown with close grey at the sides. The thick neck and slouch of a man who has spent his life strapped into a cargo hauler's seat.
vance.personality: Gruff, fatalistic, unshakeably steady — seen it all, spooked by little, which makes his unease on this run land all the harder.
vance.wardrobe: A faded olive-drab merchant-marine jumpsuit with a cargo-guild patch on the shoulder, a grease-smudged open collar, a battered headset hooked over one ear.

kort.role: Young co-pilot on the second drayman of Vance's convoy; the first to say out loud what everyone is feeling.
kort.appearance: Human woman in her late 20s, slight and wiry, warm brown skin, tightly-coiled black hair pulled back under a headset, wide anxious dark eyes, a light scatter of freckles across the nose. A young spacer who has not yet grown the calluses for this run.
kort.personality: Jumpy, earnest, quick-witted — apprehensive and honest about it, voicing the dread the older crews swallow.
kort.wardrobe: A slightly-too-big grey merchant flight jacket with rolled cuffs over a rust-orange undershirt, a guild lanyard around the neck, a comm headset.

pirate.role: Generic archetype: hostile raider / Kindred pirate encountered in flight and scripted ambushes.
pirate.appearance: Human raider of indeterminate age, hard-living and unshaven, pale skin marred by a crude cybernetic eye implant and old scars. A sneer of broken teeth, greasy dark hair, a wild dangerous stare.
pirate.personality: Cocky, cruel, taunting. Enjoys the threat more than the payoff.
pirate.wardrobe: A patchwork of scavenged armor plates over dark grease-stained flight leathers, mismatched straps, a bandolier, a red raider's marking painted on the shoulder.

militia.role: Generic archetype: local system militia pilot who scans and polices trade lanes.
militia.appearance: Human pilot in their 30s, clean-cut and slightly officious, average build, short regulation haircut, a wary by-the-book expression.
militia.personality: Officious, procedural, quick to suspect smugglers. Not cruel, just doing the job.
militia.wardrobe: A grey-green militia flight suit with a system patch, a light helmet with the visor up, a comm mic. Regional-military neat but low-budget.

confed.role: Generic archetype: Terran Confederation naval pilot / officer, the reach of the central government.
confed.appearance: Human officer in their 40s, disciplined and clean-shaven, sharp posture, short military hair, a cool professional gaze. Well-fed, well-drilled.
confed.personality: Formal, authoritative, faintly disdainful of frontier privateers. Rule-bound.
confed.wardrobe: A navy-blue Confederation naval uniform with rank insignia at the collar, silver buttons, a peaked cap or headset. Crisp and official.

bounty_hunter.role: Generic archetype: Mercenaries' Guild bounty hunter; enforcers of the Palan blockade and later grudge-holders.
bounty_hunter.appearance: Human mercenary of hard middle age, weathered and muscular, a squared-off jaw, a full-face targeting scanner monocle over one eye, a shaved scarred scalp, a flat professional stare.
bounty_hunter.personality: Cold, methodical, professional. No taunts, no mercy — this is a contract.
bounty_hunter.wardrobe: Heavy matte-black composite armor with a Mercenaries' Guild sigil, reinforced shoulder pauldrons, tactical webbing, a slung sidearm. Serious kit.

mack.role: Veteran merchant hauler based at Achilles in the Troy system; a friendly old-timer who shows new pilots around.
mack.appearance: Human man in his 60s, weathered and stout with a ruddy sun-baked face, thick grey mutton-chop sideburns, and a balding pate fringed with wild white hair. Deep laugh lines around squinting pale-blue eyes. Missing a front tooth. The look of a man who has been hauling cargo since before the war and has stories he'll tell whether you want them or not.
mack.personality: Jovial, talkative, grandfatherly. Treats every new pilot like a lost nephew. Chatty to a fault, genuinely kind, slightly hard of hearing so he talks louder than necessary.
mack.wardrobe: A faded orange merchant guild coverall with patches on both knees, a battered leather cap with earflaps, fingerless gloves, and a tarnished guild pin on the chest. Well-worn and comfortable.
